definition: One simulated child of Panem per seed, followed through every reaping from age 12 to 18. Each year the child's slips go into their district's bowl (boys and girls separately); one name per bowl is drawn (two in the Second Quarter Quell). A reaped child from a Career district is usually replaced by a volunteer. A child who enters the arena wins with probability proportional to their strength among all tributes; otherwise dies. Victors are never reaped again.

rules.source: Hunger Games Wiki: Reaping, Tessera (citing The Hunger Games ch. 1-2, Sunrise on the Reaping ch. 1-2, Catching Fire ch. 12-14); Wikipedia: Sunrise on the Reaping. Read 18.11.2026.
rules.base_slips: age - 11 (1 slip at 12, cumulative +1 each year, 7 at 18)
rules.tessera: one tessera = a year's supply of grain and oil for one person; one extra slip per tessera, for each family member, cumulative over the years taken
rules.tributes: one boy and one girl per district, 12 districts, 24 tributes; Second Quarter Quell (50th Games): two boys and two girls per district, 48 tributes
rules.careers: Districts 1, 2 and 4: children train and usually volunteer (Hunger Games Wiki, Reaping / Volunteering)

assumptions.population: District 12: about 8,000 (canon, Mockingjay ch. 1 via Hunger Games Wiki). Other districts: not given in the books. The Hunger Games Wiki states a Panem population of 4,556,778 'according to the Capitol' (no source); assumed about 4 million people in Districts 1-11, split equally (363,000 each).
assumptions.per_age_share: 1.8% of a district's population in each one-year age group 12-18 (a young, poor population), half boys, half girls.
assumptions.poor_share: Share of children whose family takes tesserae. District 12: most live in the Seam (assumed 85%); poorer districts 10-11 high, Career districts 1, 2, 4 low (the wiki notes tesserae are far rarer there). All numbers are the author's guesses.
assumptions.family_tesserae: A tesserae-taking child takes one tessera per family member every year since 12; family members fed: 2 to 6, equally likely (canon examples: Katniss 3, Gale 5).
assumptions.volunteer_rate: In Career districts a reaped child is replaced by a volunteer 90% of the time.
assumptions.career_strength: In the arena a Career volunteer has 3 times the winning chance of any other tribute; every tribute who is not the winner dies (one victor per Games).

quell.label: A random child of Panem whose reaping years include the Second Quarter Quell

d12_quell.label: A District 12 child whose reaping years include the Second Quarter Quell

equal.label: Assumption: every district the size of District 12 (8,000)

luck_only.label: Assumption: no Career advantage in the arena

method: One child of Panem per seed through the reapings at ages 12-18 under the books' rules (slips by age, cumulative tesserae, one boy and one girl per district, two each in the Second Quarter Quell); district sizes, tesserae families, volunteers and arena strength are the author's assumptions. Exact counts; 95% Wilson intervals measure sampling only.
